scope: Synthetic receipt negatives for the bounded goal observer only; gameplay success is checked separately against actual producers.

checks.name: Pre-eligibility and stale receipt sequences cannot begin a goal
A dormant first visit cannot observe a round trip
Seat before imprint and native observation alone cannot complete
Mixed grain IDs cannot combine imprint, seat or extraction proof
A new pre-seat grip starts a clean attempt
Relaxed imprint must be earned again before seating
Implicit region-hidden release cannot satisfy the final release
Core Work or hidden receipts are skipped on resume
Another free grain near the native path cannot finish the chosen journey
Held/seated grain or incorrect ledger ownership cannot finish
A release must have a subsequent real trajectory advance
Reacquiring the released grain invalidates prior release proof
Correct ordered same-grain proof completes only once
